_note: DriveTrack sector step 1 (2026-11-05): sector-END fractions of lap (S3=1.0=finish, dropped when writing sectorPoints because LapTimer takes the first 2 points). Lovely Sim Racing track data: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (README footer; repo root has no LICENSE file). track-atlas: MIT code, data under ODbL (OSM geometry) + upstream terms; its start_finish anchors and Laguna Seca measured sector-end lines are used as anchors/cross-checks. Sector data in packages is always pending (sectorNote), never verified/official. Anchors are track-atlas start_finish for all 9 mapped packages: 5 of our own starts were proven misplaced (see startCorrection) and are corrected together with the sector write, because LapTimer sectors only work when the lap origin equals the sector origin.
